items.title: Master As-Needed M23 General Engineering Services – Manson - Contract Award
items.text: Master As-Needed M23 General Engineering Services – Manson - Contract Award Staff Recommendation: Award Master As-Needed Agreement M23 General Engineering Services with a not-to-exceed amount of $3,000,000 for 730 consecutive calendar days to Manson Construction Co. Also, authorize the Director of Public Works to approve future modifications to increase the contract duration by up to 1,095 calendar days, to a new total duration of up to 1,825 calendar days, and to increase the not-to-exceed amount by up to $1,500,000, for a new total not-to- exceed amount of $4,500,000 each.
items.parent: Consent Calendar of Routine Matters Regular Items for Consideration

items.title: Master As-Needed M23 General Engineering Services – Yerba Buena - Contract Award
items.text: Master As-Needed M23 General Engineering Services – Yerba Buena - Contract Award Staff Recommendation: Award Master As-Needed Agreement M23 General Engineering Services with a not-to-exceed amount of $3,000,000 for 730 consecutive calendar days to Yerba Buena Engineering & Construction, Inc., and authorize the Director of Public Works to approve future modifications to increase the contract duration by up to 1,095 calendar days, to a new total duration of up to 1,825 calendar days, and to increase the not-to-exceed amount by up to $1,500,000, for a new total not-to-exceed amount of $4,500,000 each.
items.parent: Consent Calendar of Routine Matters Regular Items for Consideration

items.title: Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital Inpatient Adolescent Behavioral Health Services Early Demolition - Contract Award
items.text: Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital Inpatient Adolescent Behavioral Health Services Early Demolition - Contract Award Staff Recommendation: Award Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital Inpatient Adolescent Behavioral Health Services Early Demolition construction contract in the amount of $1,854,104 for 120 consecutive calendar days to Charles Pankow Builders, Ltd to complete demolition work, GPR scanning and floorplan layout for a new behavioral health facility on the 7th floor of Building 5 at Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital located at 1001 Potrero Avenue.
items.parent: Consent Calendar of Routine Matters Regular Items for Consideration
